headline: FY28 budget development, equipment bid approvals, and policy changes on home study students and student expression.
summary: The meeting will cover FY28 budget development and approval of equipment bids. It will also include second readings of policies C6 and C11 and a first reading of policy B8 on electronic communications between employees and students.
